functions.name: View Freelancer Profile
functions.effect: Retrieve approved Profile and FreelancerProfile fields in one response.

functions.name: Update Freelancer Profile
functions.effect: Persist basic and professional fields together or create a pending revision under the review policy.

functions.name: View Freelancer Skill List
functions.effect: Join FreelancerSkill with active Skill catalog entries and show proficiency levels.

functions.name: Add Freelancer Skill
functions.effect: Resolve or create the canonical catalog skill and insert one owned FreelancerSkill mapping.

functions.name: Delete Freelancer Skill
functions.effect: Hard-delete the owned mapping while retaining its Skill catalog entry.

functions.name: View Portfolio List
functions.effect: List only non-deleted PortfolioItem records of the selected freelancer.

functions.name: Add Portfolio
functions.effect: Create an owned portfolio item with title, description, technologies and project link.

functions.name: View Portfolio Detail
functions.effect: Display a single non-deleted portfolio item and its external project link.

functions.name: Update Portfolio
functions.effect: Save validated edits on an owned, non-deleted portfolio item.

functions.name: Delete Portfolio
functions.effect: Set deletedAt and remove the item from active list and detail results.

functions.name: Upload Identity Documents
functions.effect: Validate the active-request constraint, securely store the submitted evidence, and record the verification outcome for review.

functions.name: View Verification Status
functions.effect: Return the latest verification state and submission history with rejection notes where present.

functions.name: View Client Profile
functions.effect: Combine approved public Profile, ClientProfile and SocialLink fields without private user information.

functions.name: Update Company Information
functions.effect: Save or submit the authenticated Client company information according to the revision policy.

functions.name: View Social Link List
functions.effect: Retrieve links for the current account settings or the public client response; public freelancer rendering is a tracked gap.

functions.name: Add Social Link
functions.effect: Validate the platform and external URL, then insert one link on the authenticated user profile.

functions.name: Delete Social Link
functions.effect: Hard-delete the selected owned social link after confirmation.

functions.name: View Favorite Freelancer List
functions.effect: Load the current Client favorites and join public freelancer details.

functions.name: Add Freelancer to Favorites
functions.effect: Insert a unique relationship from the current Client to an active freelancer.

functions.name: Remove Freelancer from Favorites
functions.effect: Hard-delete the current Client relationship and update the favorite toggle and list.

functions.name: View Following List
functions.effect: Load freelancer relationships owned by the current Client and show the following state.

functions.name: Follow Freelancer
functions.effect: Create a unique follow mapping and notify the target freelancer.

functions.name: Unfollow Freelancer
functions.effect: Remove only the current Client follow relationship.

functions.name: View Notification List
functions.effect: Load the recipient active notifications in reverse chronological order.

functions.name: Mark Notification as Read
functions.effect: Set isRead to true on one owned notification.

functions.name: Mark All Notifications as Read
functions.effect: Update the current recipient unread, non-deleted notifications together.

functions.name: Delete Notification
functions.effect: Set deletedAt on the owned notification and hide it from the list.

functions.name: Switch Role
functions.effect: Change the primary role to an already assigned role and issue updated authentication tokens.

functions.name: Join New Role
functions.effect: Enroll in an allowed new role without duplicating the account or granting administrator privileges.

functions.name: View Review List
functions.effect: Retrieve reviews and active responses for a contract after verifying participant access.

functions.name: View Review Detail
functions.effect: Retrieve one review and response after checking contract participation.

functions.name: Write Review
functions.effect: Create one review of the other participant in a completed contract and notify that participant.

functions.name: Update Review
functions.effect: Update accepted fields of an existing review authored by the current user.

functions.name: Delete Review
functions.effect: Soft-delete the owned review so it no longer appears as active feedback.

functions.name: Respond to Review
functions.effect: Create an active response from the reviewee and notify the review author.

functions.name: Update Review Response
functions.effect: Save validated text in the current user response.

functions.name: Delete Review Response
functions.effect: Soft-delete the response authored by the current user.

functions.name: View Profile
functions.effect: Read the authenticated account profile, email and assigned roles.

functions.name: Update Profile
functions.effect: Save or submit general display name and biography according to profile strength.

functions.name: Change Password
functions.effect: Verify the current credential, hash the confirmed replacement and update the password.

functions.name: Upload Avatar
functions.effect: Validate image content and size, store it, and update the owned avatar URL.

functions.name: View Pending Profile Update Request List
functions.effect: Filter and paginate revisions, defaulting the review workflow to pending requests.

functions.name: View Profile Update Request Detail
functions.effect: Display the current and proposed snapshots, requester, profile type and prior review notes.

functions.name: Approve Profile Update Request
functions.effect: Apply validated proposed changes and record an APPROVED decision atomically.

functions.name: Reject Profile Update Request
functions.effect: Keep approved profile data unchanged and record REJECTED with an explanatory note.

functions.name: View Profile Update Request History
functions.effect: Allow Admin to filter historical decisions; a requester can read only their latest revision for a profile type.

functions.name: Update Profile Expert
functions.effect: Submit the owned Expert profile as a pending revision for administrator review.

functions.name: Upload CV
functions.effect: Validate a PDF up to 10 MB and attach it to the owned FreelancerProfile.
functions.input: CV upload: multipart PDF file, maximum 10 MB; Profile.id

functions.name: View CV
functions.effect: Authorize the owner and serve or redirect to the current CV; return 404 when its stored file is unavailable.
functions.input: CV upload: multipart PDF file, maximum 10 MB; Profile.id

functions.name: Replace CV
functions.effect: Store a valid replacement PDF, update CV metadata and clean up the previous file after a successful update.
functions.input: CV upload: multipart PDF file, maximum 10 MB; Profile.id

functions.name: Delete CV
functions.effect: Clear CV URL, public ID, file name and upload time, and update the related search index.
functions.input: CV upload: multipart PDF file, maximum 10 MB; Profile.id
